```{r}
#| include: true
root <- here::here()
if (!exists("Tn.target") || length(Tn.target) != 1L) Tn.target <- 0
if (!exists("p.target") || !length(p.target)) p.target <- c("0.10", "0.16", "0.50", "0.84", "0.90")
TRT.target <- GMPETable[ID %in% ID.target, TRT][1]
# Snap to the producer magnitude grid: the caption quotes the cell plotted.
AUX <- sort(unique(GMPETable[ID %in% ID.target, Mw]))
Mw.target <- AUX[which.min(abs(Mw.target - AUX))]
rm(AUX)
if (!exists("CAP", inherits = FALSE)) CAP <- readCaption("fig.GMPE")
```
